reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed. L34 of src/app/auth/callback/route.ts unconditionally executes `console.log('[AUTH CALLBACK] Code (first 20 chars):', code.substring(0, 20) + '...')` with no environment guard or redaction, directly violating the property assertion. An attacker can trigger this via any Discord OAuth login flow by initiating an auth callback, and any party with read access to server-side logs (container stdout, Vercel log drain, or log aggregation) can extract the 20-char auth code prefix during the exchange window. Note: L27 also logs the full request.url containing the complete raw code parameter, which is a more severe co-located leak warranting separate review.
